fato_historico: 2018: LGBT rights activist Zak Kostopoulos is beaten to death on a busy street in Athens.
energia_do_dia: Today, your fiery nature may shine with extra intensity. Consider channeling your passion into acts of radical kindness and advocacy for those whose voices are silenced. As the sun highlights the courage required to stand for justice in even the busiest of streets, it is a good time to protect your inner light and spread warmth to everyone you encounter.
frase_do_dia: Let your brave heart be the beacon that guides others toward peace and love.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic energy of leadership and potential for spiritual transformation.
conselho: Stand tall for what is right while keeping your compassionate soul wide open today.
